articles.title: ‘People couldn’t deal with watching an animal die’: the strange saga of Timmy the whale – and how a whole country lost its mind
articles.summary:
When the humpback got stranded on Germany’s Baltic coast, crowds gathered, conspiracy theorists pitted themselves against scientists and animal lovers argued with vets. Why did the animal trigger such an intense derangement?

What surprised Bodo Köpnick was how loud the whale was. “You could hear it as far away as the next village. It was eerie, but also impressive,” he says, then pauses to think how best to describe the noise a suffering humpback makes at night. “It was like a cow moaning. It went to your marrow.”

Köpnick, 65, is everything you would hope for in a volunteer fire chief on a sleepy holiday island: a grandfatherly figure who mostly spends his weekends teaching local children about health and safety, and letting them climb on the engines. But on 31 March his life was made infinitely more stressful by the appearance of a lost whale that had got itself stranded on the shores of his island of Poel, in northern Germany. It became his fate to stand on the shoreline and guard the huge creature while behind him an entire country lost its mind.

articles.title: Tourists are throwing fewer coins into Rome’s Trevi fountain – is €2 entry fee to blame?
articles.summary:
Charity that collects the coins says donations are down by £200,000 after a barrier was put in place to restrict access

When Jeff Clinton, an American visiting Rome with his wife for the first time, found a US one-cent coin on a street close to Termini train station, he knew precisely what he was going to do with it. “I’ll throw it into the Trevi fountain,” said Clinton, holding the copper coin in the palm of his hand as the couple admired the landmark.

He was well aware of the tradition among tourists of tossing a coin over their shoulder and into the waters of the baroque masterpiece, in a ritual fabled to ensure a return visit to the city or make other dreams come true.

archive.security_status_en: The security situation in Europe remains highly tense amid a series of incidents including Russian provocations in Poland and the Baltic Sea, alongside escalating diplomatic friction. Simultaneously, intense debates are underway regarding the EU's seven-year budget reform, a proposed Big Tech digital tax, and the reshaping of post-Brexit relations with the UK.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat zostřenou rétoriku vůči Rusku po incidentu v Polsku a pokračující napjatá vyjednávání v rámci evropských institucí ohledně rozpočtu.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, heightened rhetoric against Russia following the incident in Poland and continued tense negotiations within EU institutions regarding the budget are expected.
